note: Science facts and Islamic reflections (tadabbur) are kept strictly separate. Scholarly review recommended before public release.

visuals.title: Animal Cell — Architecture of Life
visuals.alt: 3D animated landscape cutaway of an animal cell showing nucleus, mitochondria and Golgi apparatus

parts.name: Cell Membrane
parts.role: Outer protective boundary jo control karti hai kya andar-bahar jayega.

parts.name: Nucleus
parts.role: Cell ka control center jismein genetic instructions (DNA) rehti hain.

parts.name: Mitochondria
parts.role: Energy powerhouse jo food se ATP energy banata hai.

parts.name: Golgi & ER
parts.role: Proteins banane, pack karne aur transport karne ka system.

visuals.science: Har living organism cells se bana hai. Ek animal cell ka lagbhag 70% se 80% hissa paani (cytoplasm) hota hai, jismein sabhi organelles mil kar kaam karte hain.

quran.text: Humne paani se har zinda cheez banayi (21:30). Khud tumhare andar bhi nishaniyan hain, kya tum dekhte nahi? (51:21).

hadith.text: Jis tarah momin ek jism ki tarah mil kar kaam karte hain, usi tarah ek chhote cell ke andar har organelle coordination se zindagi chalata hai.

visuals.reflection: Ek microscopic cell ke andar itna organized system dekh kar aapko Allah ki qudrat ke baare mein kya ehsaas hota hai?

visuals.title: DNA Double Helix — Genetic Code
visuals.alt: 3D animated landscape view of glowing DNA double helix strands and base pairs

parts.name: Double Helix Backbone
parts.role: Sugar aur phosphate ki do twisted strands jo code ko safe rakhti hain.

parts.name: Base Pairs (A-T, C-G)
parts.role: 4 chemical letters ka exact sequence jo body traits decide karta hai.

parts.name: Genes
parts.role: DNA ke specific segments jo proteins banane ki instructions dete hain.

visuals.science: Har insaan ka DNA lagbhag 3 billion base pairs ka bana hota hai, jo har cell ko batata hai ki use kaise grow aur repair karna hai.

quran.text: Wohi hai jisne tumhe paida kiya, theek-thaak banaya aur jis surat mein chaha jod diya (82:7-8). Ungliyon ke por tak durust banane par qadir hai (75:4).

hadith.text: Maa ke pet mein insaan ki takhleeq ke munazzam marahil (stages) ka bayan — jo har fard ki unique creation par ghaur ki dawat deta hai.

visuals.reflection: DNA ek biological code hai; iski precision dekh kar hum apni zindagi ke maqsad par kaise ghaur kar sakte hain?

visuals.title: Human Brain — Thinking & Memory
visuals.alt: 3D animated landscape view of a glowing human brain with neural impulses

parts.name: Prefrontal Cortex
parts.role: Peshani ke peeche ka hissa jo planning, faisle aur self-control sambhalta hai.

parts.name: Cerebrum
parts.role: Sochna, bhasha samajhna, yaaddaasht aur senses process karna.

parts.name: Cerebellum
parts.role: Body ka balance aur smooth movement control karna.

parts.name: Brainstem
parts.role: Saans, heartbeat aur neend jaise automatic functions chalana.

visuals.science: Insaani dimaag mein lagbhag 86 billion neurons hote hain jo electrical signals ke zariye seekhne, yaad rakhne aur faisle lene ka kaam karte hain.

quran.ref: Surah Al-Mulk 67:23; Surah Al-Alaq 96:15-16; Surah Al-Baqarah 2:44
quran.text: Allah ne tumhe sunne, dekhne aur samajhne ki quwwat di (67:23). Qur'an baar-baar poochta hai: 'Afala ta'qilun?' — kya tum aql se kaam nahi lete?

hadith.text: Aamaal ka daromadar niyyaton par hai (Bukhari 1). Jo ilm ki talaash mein nikalta hai, Allah uske liye Jannat ka raasta aasaan kar deta hai (Muslim 2699).

visuals.reflection: Aap rozana apne dimaag ko distractions ke bajay kaunse faydemand ilm mein lagana chahenge?

visuals.title: Neuron Synapse & AI Neural Networks
visuals.alt: 3D animated landscape view of a biological neuron firing electrical impulses across a synapse

parts.name: Dendrites
parts.role: Doosre neurons se incoming signals receive karna.

parts.name: Axon
parts.role: Electrical impulse ko high speed par aage bhejna.

parts.name: Synapse & Vesicles
parts.role: Chemical messengers (neurotransmitters) ke zariye agle neuron tak message pahunchana.

visuals.science: Revision aur practice se synaptic connections strong hote hain (Neuroplasticity). Modern AI Artificial Neural Networks isi biological design se inspired hain, par AI galti bhi kar sakta hai.

quran.text: Dua: 'Rabbi zidni ilma' (20:114). Aur koi bhi khabar ya AI output aage badhane se pehle uski tasdeeq/verification karo (49:6).

hadith.text: Qur'an ki paabandi se dohrani (revision) karo — jaise bandha hua oont paabandi se qabu mein rehta hai; chhod do to nikal jaata hai.

visuals.reflection: Spaced revision (baar-baar dohrana) hamare brain aur Hifz dono ko kaise mazboot karta hai?

visuals.title: Earth Rotation, Sun & Moon Orbits
visuals.alt: 3D animated landscape view of Earth rotating between sunlight and night with the Moon in space

parts.name: Sunlight (Day Side)
parts.role: Earth ka jo hissa Sooraj ke saamne hota hai wahan din hota hai.

parts.name: Night Side
parts.role: Opposite side par raat hoti hai jahan city lights aur aaram ka waqt hai.

parts.name: Moon Orbit
parts.role: Chaand ki manzilein (phases) lunar/Hijri mahino aur Ramadan/Eid ka hisab batati hain.

visuals.science: Earth apni axis par 24 ghante mein ek rotation poori karti hai jisse din-raat badalte hain, aur Moon Earth ke gird ~29.5 din mein ek lunar cycle poora karta hai.

quran.ref: Surah Aal-e-Imran 3:190-191; Surah Ya-Sin 36:40; Surah Yunus 10:5
quran.text: Aasmanon aur zameen ki takhleeq aur raat-din ke badalne mein aql walon ke liye nishaniyan hain (3:190). Har ek apne falak (orbit) mein tair raha hai (36:40).

hadith.text: Sooraj aur chaand Allah ki nishaniyon mein se do nishaniyan hain; kisi ki maut ya paidaish ki wajah se inhe grahan nahi lagta.

visuals.reflection: Din aur raat ka itna exact nizam dekh kar waqt ki qadr (time discipline) ke baare mein kya seekh milti hai?

visuals.title: Al-Quran — Tadabbur & Meaning
visuals.alt: 3D animated landscape scene of the Holy Quran resting on a wooden rehal with warm lanterns and crescent moon

parts.name: Arabic Text (Mushaf)
parts.role: Original wahi ke alfaaz jinhe tajweed ke saath padhna zaroori hai.

parts.name: Root Words (Sarf)
parts.role: 3-harfi Arabic roots samajhne se poore Qur'an ke maani aasaan hote hain.

parts.name: Tafsir & Tadabbur
parts.role: Moatabar ulama ki tafsir padh kar zindagi mein amal karna.

visuals.science: Structured learning research batati hai ki root-based vocabulary aur active reflection se nayi zabaan aur concepts 3x zyada der tak yaad rehte hain.

quran.text: Ye barkat wali kitab humne aap par nazil ki taaki log iski ayaton par ghaur (tadabbur) karein (38:29). Humne Qur'an ko nasihat ke liye aasaan kar diya (54:17).

hadith.text: Tum mein sabse behtar woh hai jo Qur'an seekhe aur sikhaye (Bukhari 5027). Qur'an padha karo kyunki woh Qayamat ke din shafa'at karega (Muslim 804).

visuals.reflection: Aaj aap Qur'an ki kis ek ayat ka tarjuma samajh kar apni daily life mein apply karenge?

visuals.title: Geometry, Symmetry & Fairness
visuals.alt: 2D geometric symmetry and Islamic pattern diagram

parts.name: Symmetry
parts.role: Barabar hisse aur balance jo Islamic architecture aur nature mein dikhta hai.

parts.name: Ratios & Measurement
parts.role: Sateek naap-tol jo engineering, mirath aur tijarat ka base hai.

visuals.science: Geometry shapes, angles aur spatial balance ki study hai jisse architecture, engineering aur computer graphics bante hain.

quran.text: Naap-tol mein kami karne walon ke liye sakht warning hai; insaaf ke saath poora tolo aur tarazu mein kami na karo.

hadith.text: Jisne dhoka diya woh hum mein se nahi hai — measurement aur business mein imaandari imaan ka hissa hai.

visuals.reflection: Math sirf exam ka subject nahi, balki insaaf aur imaandari ka zariya kaise hai?

visuals.title: Islamic History & Source Verification
visuals.alt: 2D source verification and historical timeline diagram

parts.name: Primary Source (Sanad)
parts.role: Waqiye ki asli riwayat aur chain of narration check karna.

parts.name: Cross-Checking
parts.role: Tareekh, jagah aur reliable historians se compare karna.

visuals.science: Historical method mein kisi bhi claim ko sach maanne se pehle primary evidence, date aur multiple independent sources verify kiye jaate hain.

quran.text: Agar koi khabar lekar aaye to uski achhi tarah tahqeeq (verify) kar lo, kahin anjane mein kisi ko nuqsan na pahuncha baitho.

hadith.text: Kisi shakhs ke jhoota hone ke liye itna hi kaafi hai ki woh har suni-sunayi baat bina jaanche aage bayan kar de.

visuals.reflection: WhatsApp ya social media par koi Islamic story forward karne se pehle aap kaunse 2 checks karenge?
